stem:
Carolyn will buy the same number of stamps every month to add to a stamp collection her grandfather gave her. The table shows the number of stamps Carolyn will have at the end of x months.

Carolyn's Stamp Collection

Number of Months, x  1  3  6  10
Number of Stamps, y  250  350  500  700

How many stamps was Carolyn given, and how many stamps will she buy every month?

options.label: A
options.text: Carolyn was given 200 stamps, and she will buy 50 stamps every month.

options.label: B
options.text: Carolyn was given 180 stamps, and she will buy 70 stamps every month.

options.label: C
options.text: Carolyn was given 180 stamps, and she will buy 50 stamps every month.

options.label: D
options.text: Carolyn was given 200 stamps, and she will buy 70 stamps every month.
